hero.subheadline: A smart coaching system that supports coaches and clients by uniting training, physiology, and behavioral patterns.
hero.body: JOMOA makes it easier to understand how the body changes over time – and to adapt training to real conditions.
hero.ctaSubtext: Get news and invitations to the beta launch.

problem.heading:
Today's training tools are built on linear assumptions.
The human body is not.
problem.body1: Traditional apps often assume that energy, recovery, and performance are stable from day to day.
problem.body2: In practice, the body varies – both due to physiology, life situation, and behavioral patterns.
problem.body3:
With JOMOA, coaches get a tool that works for all clients,
and that simultaneously makes it easier to understand variations that are particularly common in women.

variation.heading: Energy, recovery, and motivation vary naturally.
variation.subheading: This is not a problem – it's important information.
items: Energy can shift significantly over a month
Recovery is affected by sleep, load, and physiological factors
Motivation follows behavioral patterns and life situation
Performance goes in waves, not in a straight line
variation.footer: JOMOA helps coaches and clients see these patterns – without simplifying or exaggerating.

phases.heading: Support for different phases and conditions
phases.subheading: A tool that accounts for reality.
phases.body1: JOMOA is not an app "for women".
phases.body2: It's a tool designed for everyone – but with the ability to handle variations that often affect women's daily life and training capacity.
phases.examplesHeading: Examples of situations where JOMOA adds value:

items.title: cyclical symptoms and recurring variations in energy
periods of increased sensitivity or discomfort
hormone-related conditions that can affect load tolerance

phases.footer1: The client gets a comprehensible way to follow their patterns.
phases.footer2: The coach gets better foundation for adapting the approach.

data.heading: Data-driven — but human.
data.insight: The system presents the information in a way that is easy to understand – and practical to use.
data.client: "I see how my body reacts over time."
data.coach: "I can adapt training with more precision."

features.heading: A tool for coaches who work long-term.

items.title: Structured programming
items.description: Plan blocks, cycles, and progression in a way that's easy to adjust.

items.title: Session log and development over time
items.description: Sets, reps, RPE, comments, trends, and graphs.

items.title: Nutrition support and adjustments
items.description: Simple recipes, portion guidance, and recommendations during low energy.

items.title: Psychological markers
items.description: Clients can log mood and energy – without it becoming a diagnostic tool.

items.title: Cycle module (optional)
items.description: For clients where variation is relevant.

forEveryone.heading: For all clients – but especially valuable for women
forEveryone.body: JOMOA can be used with clients who:
clients: have high workload or insufficient recovery
experience recurring variations in energy or symptoms
want to understand their body better over time
forEveryone.footer: The formulations are inclusive, scientifically cautious, and professionally neutral.

steps.heading: How it works – three steps
steps.intro: A simple process for building, following, and adapting training over time.

items.title: Build the program
items.description: Create structured training blocks and progressions.

items.title: Follow the patterns
items.description: The client logs training and simple markers. JOMOA visualizes trends.

items.title: Adapt at the right time
items.description: Small adjustments – clear effect in the long term.
